messages:
sam-sales: New RFP from AtlasPay (payments infra). They want a 4-week pilot with Private deployment, tenant isolation, KMS/HSM, and dedicated throughput for fraud scoring endpoints. RFP + questionnaire: https://drive.company/atlaspay-rfp.pdf
olga-solutions: Do they require on-prem or VPC?
sam-sales: Private VPC with option to move to on-prem later. POC should mirror their network DMZ and gateway.
tariq-eng: For dedicated throughput, ask for expected qps per endpoint and typical sequence lengths. Without that we can't size GPUs.
sam-sales: They listed "~500 qps per scoring endpoint (6 endpoints), 99th < 200ms" in appendix.
tariq-eng: Good. For a POC we can propose a small Dedicated pool (4x A40 equiv) + autoscale policy. Will need to add KV cache and prefix caching in config.
olga-solutions: I'll create capability matrix rows for: per-tenant isolation, private control plane, KMS/HSM, audit export, SOC2/ISO notes, integration with API gateways (mTLS), and peering options.
lena-security: HSM requires enterprise ent addendum; we can support customer-managed KMS in Private now. Also need to call out key rotation policy and attestations.
carter-product: Pricing ask: they want a line-itemed POC quote (infra + eng support hours + logs retention). Also ask about SLA for Dedicated (uptime & latency penalties).
sam-sales: They also attached a vendor comparison sheet we should fill out. I'll upload it here.
infra-bot: Attached: atlaspay-vendor-sheet.xlsx (https://files.company/cap-matrix/2065567890.xlsx)
olga-solutions: I'll draft the RFP response and a POC SOW. Can we commit to delivery by Wed EOD?
tariq-eng: I can spare 3 hours for the technical review Tue 3pm PT.
lena-security: Security review Wed 10am PT works. Need the draft questionnaire answers beforehand.
carter-product: I'll review SLA language and pricing tiers after the SOW draft.
sam-sales: Action items: Olga = RFP answers + SOW; Tariq = perf config + example autoscale; Lena = security answers; Carter = pricing. I'll tell AtlasPay we can deliver draft packet by Thu.
olga-solutions: Quick config example for batching/throughput I will include in SOW: {"batch_max":128, "latency_target_ms":120, "autoscale_step_qps":400}.
tariq-eng: Also include fallback policy: degrade to smaller model variant or cached responses for spikes.
lena-security: Include audit log retention options (30/90/365) + SIEM connectors (syslog, S3).
sam-sales: Perfect. I'll attach RFP PDF and their network sketch to the final thread. (uploaded atlaspay-network.png)
infra-bot: Thread tagged with #sales for tracking.
